GAB.note: Nothing on civil register and ID exchange.
A planned single medical record and identifier; no system in service stated.

facts.fact: Gabon's Council of Ministers adopted a draft law fixing the interoperability framework of the health information system (SIS), meant to connect public and private health facilities to one digital architecture.

GAB.note: The unique identifier is a health-sector one, not a number at birth registration.
Nothing on the national ID system's operation.
No register keyed on the national ID number.
Only a health patient identifier draft law; not the national ID system.
The framework is for the health information system, not a government-wide framework.
